title: Marketing Tech Ops - GHL Specialist
description:
About the job

GoHighLevel (GHL) Specialist — Remote, Mexico

Harvest Health Marketing, a division of Harvest Company, is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency that works exclusively with cash-pay chiropractic clinics. GoHighLevel is the backbone of everything we build for our clients — from lead capture to follow-up automation to appointment booking — and we need someone who knows the platform inside and out.

We are looking for an experienced GHL Specialist based in Mexico who can build complex automations, troubleshoot technical issues, create high-converting landing pages, set up SMS campaigns, manage A2P registration for client phone numbers, and configure accurate ad-platform tracking. This is a technical role that requires precision, problem-solving, and the ability to work closely with a U.S.-based team in real time.

About the Role

You will own the technical buildout and ongoing maintenance of GoHighLevel systems for our chiropractic clinic clients. Every client we onboard needs a fully functional GHL environment — pipelines, automations, landing pages, forms, calendars, SMS campaigns, email sequences, and conversion tracking — built correctly from the start and maintained as the business evolves.

You will work directly with our team to understand each client's workflow and translate that into a GHL build that runs without constant intervention. When things break — and sometimes they do — you will be the person who diagnoses and fixes it quickly.

This role requires daily availability during business hours for team meetings via Microsoft Teams. Strong communication is non-negotiable. If you cannot attend live meetings or communicate clearly in English, this role is not the right fit.

Required Skills & Experience

To be considered, you must meet all of the following:

• 3+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience — not familiarity, actual buildout and management experience

• Proven ability to build complex, multi-step automations including conditional logic, triggers, wait steps, and branching workflows

• Experience building and optimizing landing pages inside GHL — forms, funnels, and conversion-focused design

• Experience setting up SMS campaigns including drip sequences, appointment reminders, and lead follow-up automations

• Direct experience completing A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers — you understand the process, the requirements, and how to troubleshoot rejections

• Hands-on experience setting up Meta Conversions API (CAPI) — you can configure server-side event tracking for Meta/Facebook ads, including deduplication with the pixel and event matching for lead and purchase events

• Hands-on experience setting up offline conversion tracking for Google Ads — you can build and manage offline conversion imports so closed/won leads are matched back to the originating ad click

• In-depth understanding of UTM parameters and source tracking within GHL — you can set up and audit UTM tagging and traffic-source attribution so every lead can be traced back to the ad, campaign, and platform that generated it

• Strong troubleshooting ability — you can diagnose why an automation isn't firing, why a form isn't submitting, or why a message isn't delivering (or why a conversion isn't tracking) and fix it without hand-holding

• Excellent written and spoken English — you will attend daily meetings, communicate with team members, and document your builds clearly

• Fast, stable internet connection capable of supporting daily video calls via Microsoft Teams without interruption

• Availability to attend daily team meetings during U.S. business hours (schedule to be confirmed)

Applications without demonstrated GHL experience will not be reviewed. Be prepared to walk through a build you have completed.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with GHL sub-account setup and white-label agency environments

• Familiarity with Zapier or Make (Integromat) for third-party integrations

• Experience integrating GHL with Meta Lead Ads or Google Ads for automatic lead ingestion

• Background working with U.S.-based digital marketing agencies or healthcare-adjacent businesses

• Understanding of HIPAA-conscious communication practices for medical or healthcare clients




Responsibilities

• Build and configure GHL sub-accounts for new clients including pipelines, stages, tags, and custom fields

• Design and build complex automations for lead follow-up, appointment booking, no-show re-engagement, and nurture sequences

• Build landing pages, opt-in forms, and funnels optimized for patient lead generation

• Set up and manage SMS and email campaigns including A/B testing and performance monitoring

• Complete A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers and manage compliance requirements

• Set up and maintain Meta Conversions API integrations and Google Ads offline conversion imports for client accounts

• Implement and audit UTM parameters and source/attribution tracking in GHL so lead and conversion data ties back to the correct ad campaign

• Troubleshoot automation failures, integration issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform errors quickly and thoroughly

• Document all builds clearly so the team understands what was built and why

• Attend daily team meetings via Microsoft Teams and communicate progress, blockers, and completed work

• Maintain and update existing client GHL environments as strategies evolve




Compensation

• Fixed monthly rate — based on experience and scope of work

• Compensation discussed after skills assessment and initial interview

• Long-term contract with potential for rate increases as the relationship and workload grow




Who Thrives in This Role

• You are technically precise — you build things correctly the first time and test before handing off

• You communicate proactively — you flag issues before they become problems and ask questions before going in the wrong direction

• You take ownership of your builds — if something isn't working, you don't wait to be asked, you fix it

• You are reliable and present — daily meetings aren't optional and your availability during U.S. hours is consistent

• You learn fast — GHL updates frequently and you stay current without being asked

If you are looking for a role where you work independently without communication or live collaboration, this is not the right fit. We operate as a team and expect you to be a present, communicative part of it.

description:
About the job

About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a part of our first DoorDash team in our Mexico City office! 
Manage multi-million dollar monthly digital budgets across digital paid marketing channels, working with partners such as Meta, Snap, Google and TikTok to optimize campaign performance and test new products.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. About the job

About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a part of our first DoorDash team in our Mexico City office! 
Manage multi-million dollar monthly digital budgets across digital paid marketing channels, working with partners such as Meta, Snap, Google and TikTok to optimize campaign performance and test new products.

Work closely with other teams and stakeholders to ensure goals are met


We're excited about you because…


You are proficient in the English language 
You have a proven track record in the performance marketing space, with 4+ years of experience.
Direct, hands-on experience managing media buying, optimization (Paid Social), and strategic planning either at an agency or in-house
You are highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and have deep familiarity with metrics such as CPA, CPC, CVR, and LTV.
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills; must be very comfortable with data analysis and able to use data to make decisions and conduct experiments.
Experience with Web & App Tracking/Attribution (preferred)
Knowledge of SQL (preferred)
Experience working on multi-sided marketplace businesses (preferred)


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. description:
About the job

About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a part of our first DoorDash team in our Mexico City office! 
Manage multi-million dollar monthly digital budgets across digital paid marketing channels, working with partners such as Meta, Snap, Google and TikTok to optimize campaign performance and test new products.
Learn to operate a world-class acquisition program that brings in millions of orders to DoorDash, making it the top food delivery and logistics platform in the U.S.. working with our U.S. based
Maintain and monitor key metrics across channels including budget pacing, cost per acquisition and LTV proxies.
Manage an experimentation roadmap to optimize performance including A/B creative tests, incrementality tests, and bidding algo tests
Work closely with other teams and stakeholders to ensure goals are met


We're excited about you because…


You are proficient in the English language 
You have a proven track record in the performance marketing space, with 4+ years of experience.
Direct, hands-on experience managing media buying, optimization (Paid Social), and strategic planning either at an agency or in-house
You are highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and have deep familiarity with metrics such as CPA, CPC, CVR, and LTV.
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills; must be very comfortable with data analysis and able to use data to make decisions and conduct experiments.
Experience with Web & App Tracking/Attribution (preferred)
Knowledge of SQL (preferred)
Experience working on multi-sided marketplace businesses (preferred)


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Farmers Insurance is one of the United States' largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). If you’re reading this job description, you’re probably either unemployed and need a job…

…or you’re already employed, but for some reason or another…

…you’re here…

“Okay, but what even is Pilot?” 🤔

Great question. Glad you asked.

Pilot is multiplayer consumer AI for travel: the free web & mobile app where groups plan, decide, & book trips together.

💸 We’ve raised about CA$2.2M to date, from funds and from angels including the founders of Moment Energy, Nexonia, Farewill, and DayOne, plus an AI engineering leader at Meta.

description:
About the job

About Us

Fractal Power is a vertically integrated power company built for the modern grid. We own and operate across the entire stack, combining utility-scale energy storage infrastructure with algorithmic trading and dispatch to deliver power precisely where and when it’s needed most. 




We are backed by the world’s leading infrastructure and deeptech investors, including Riot, Definition, and Worldbuild.




Why Join Us?

Demand for power is growing at the fastest rate since WWII yet supply is stranded behind worsening transmission and interconnection bottlenecks. The new economy requires a new model of power delivery, one that’s vertically integrated, algorithmically operated, and co-located with demand. 




We solve the last-mile infrastructure problem by vertically integrating across the entire value chain of American power - from greenfield development, to algorithmic optimization, dispatch, and power trading across a fleet of distributed resources - allowing us to deliver power where and when it's needed most on the grid. We have the ambition, the team, and the zeal to create the next great power company and we are looking for fanatical people to join us.




Role Overview

You will own the end-to-end delivery of Fractal’s distribution-connected, utility-scale battery energy storage projects in ERCOT, from greenfield site through interconnection, construction, energization, and commercial operation.




You are the single accountable owner for every project assigned to you. You will build and defend the integrated project schedule, manage all pre-NTP development operations, administer the EPC contract, and drive the critical path across land, interconnection, permitting, procurement, engineering, construction, and commissioning. You will hold the project EPC contractor and every other party to their commitments, and you will have broad authority to pull in any resource in the company to keep projects moving.




You will be measured on whether projects reach commercial operation on schedule and on budget. You will operate with extraordinary agency, ownership, and expectations.




Key Responsibilities

Own the schedule, budget, and commercial operation date for every project assigned to you, from site control and interconnection application through energization, commissioning, and COD.
Build and maintain the integrated master schedule for each project, sequencing land, interconnection, permitting, procurement, engineering, EPC construction, and utility work into a single critical path.
Act as the owner-side administrator of the EPC contract: issue and manage work orders, review and negotiate change orders, track milestone completion and payment, and hold contractors to scope, schedule, and quality.
Drive permitting and AHJ approvals across counties and municipalities, and coordinate with transmission and distribution utilities, electric cooperatives, and ERCOT through energization and market entry
Maintain a live risk register and a project status report that is the single source of truth on where each project stands, force decisions before they turn into delays, and escalate early with a recommended path
Plan and manage commissioning, energization, and turnover to operations, including as-builts, warranties, spare parts, O&M mobilization, and the handoff of assets into our dispatch and trading operations
Represent Fractal on site and with landowners, contractors, utilities, and local officials, and enforce safety and quality expectations even where the EPC carries execution responsibility
Build Fractal’s project controls and execution playbook




Qualifications

3+ years managing utility-scale energy or infrastructure projects through construction and into operation, at a developer, IPP, owner’s engineer, or EPC contractor.
Demonstrated personal ownership of schedule and budget on projects you drove to completion, with the ability to walk through your critical path, what threatened it, and what you did about it
Command of construction contracts from the owner’s side: EPC scope, work orders, change orders, notices, milestone and completion criteria, warranties, and liquidated damages
Exceptional organization and follow-through. You plan in detail, you track every open item to closure, and nothing handed to another party gets lost
Fluent in English
Willingness to travel to project sites across Texas




What We Offer

Base salary range: $50,000 USD–$80,000 USD per year (actual offer depends on experience, skills, and qualifications)
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
Flexible PTO policy

title: Commercial Excellence Analyst
description:
About the job

Company Description 

Saya Biologics is a pioneering biopharmaceutical company in Latin America, focused on reducing the access gap to highly specialized biologic treatments. Through international strategic partnerships, we develop, register, commercialize, and distribute biologic and biosimilar medicines across the region. Our mission is to empower thousands of patients through accessible, innovative, and high-quality treatments. At Saya Biologics, you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects with a real impact on people’s lives and work in a collaborative and diverse environment driven by scientific and commercial excellence.







Role Description

As a Commercial Excellence Analyst, you will be responsible for measuring, analyzing, and tracking the performance of the sales force across Saya’s different business units. In your day-to-day work, you will build and maintain dashboards, reports, and commercial trackers to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement in coverage, productivity, frequency, conversion, and commercial efficiency. You will also support commercial operations by tracking relationships with distributors, banks, insurers, hospitals, and other institutional stakeholders, ensuring that information, commitments, and next steps are clear and up to date. You will work closely with the Commercial, Finance, and Launch Excellence teams to standardize KPIs, prepare materials for internal reviews, organize key information, and contribute to a disciplined, agile, and well-documented commercial operation. 

This role is ideal for someone in the early stages of their career who wants to learn how the commercial engine of a growing biopharmaceutical company works, combining data analysis, operational coordination, and administrative support. 

This is a full-time position.







Requirements

• Strong analytical skills to work with commercial data, interpret trends, identify deviations, and generate actionable insights. 

• Commercial skills to understand sales operations, performance indicators, commercial productivity, and relationships with stakeholders such as distributors, hospitals, banks, and insurers. 

• Organizational skills to keep dashboards, reports, trackers, repositories, and commercial documentation up to date and well structured. 

• Communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, follow up on commitments, and present information clearly and in an organized manner.

• High attention to detail and a low margin of error when handling data, reports, and follow-up materials. 

• Proactivity to identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and improvements without waiting to be asked. 

• University degree in Business Administration, Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Health Sciences, or related fields. 

• Recent graduate or up to 2 years of experience in internships, analytical, commercial, administrative roles, or related projects. 

• Solid command of Excel or Google Sheets; experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau, CRM platforms such as Salesforce or Veeva, SAP, and Notion is desirable. 

• Advanced English level for reading and writing; bilingual Spanish-English profile is desirable. 

• Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate data cleaning, analysis, and report preparation, with human judgment and care for confidential information. 

• Ability to work in a dynamic, hybrid, high-growth environment with autonomy, organization, and a results-oriented mindset.

About the job

Sourcing Specialist – Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) 

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in human resources? A Sourcing Specialist who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Sourcing Specialist, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) leverages scale and talent to provide high quality, cost effective service to our clients.




ADMX is a member of the Global Delivery Network which has presence across the world with Delivery centers in the United States, Romania, India, Spain, China, and the Philippines. ADMX is in Queretaro, Mexico. We provide consulting services to help our clients achieve a higher level of service in operational efficiency and business value. We are a team of professionals passionate about serving clients with distinction and learning, and we are driven by our purpose: Making an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and society.




The team

Talent team offers HR solutions by tapping into the different aspects of HR policies, to ensure every

professional’s engagement with the organization is meaningful. As part of the Talent Acquisition team, you will work with our business leaders to develop, implement and execute successful recruiting programs and effective reporting and analytics.




Key Roles and Responsibilities 

As a Talent Acquisition Research team, you will collaborate with stakeholders in the Sourcing /

Recruiting / Business groups to research, develop and deliver intelligence thereby enabling the

success of the company and our clients. You may work in any of our businesses involving Consulting.




The Researcher will deliver comprehensive research and on-demand intelligence for a variety of

market and functional specific requests in the Recruitment context. He/she will serve as expert on

direct sourcing strategies, tools, methodologies and practices.

• Partner with aligned stakeholders to create and implement sourcing strategies for active and

future requisitions

• Focus on target companies and industries to identify talent for various recruiting needs

• Administer reactive talent sourcing while driving towards a more proactive talent

• Pursue every available outlet (deep web, databases, networking, internet, job boards, in-house

channels) to find the intelligence/information that is requested

• Execute various types of research requests like talent mapping, market data intelligence,

compensation analysis, name generation etc.

• Recommend tools, channels, and best practices for talent attraction

• Develop holistic talent identification and research strategies to solve the business talent needs

• identify emerging recruiting platforms to optimize sourcing, pipelining and customer

experience

• Research candidates contact information including phone numbers and emails




Qualifications 

Required: 

• Completion of course of study/Egresado in any pertinent field or industry.

• +3 years of experience in research at an IT or consulting firm, or in recruitment within a

corporate environment, including passive candidate identification, market mapping, and

talent pool creation and maintenance.

• Excellent verbal/written communication skills

• Strong analytical and logical reasoning abilities

• Experience in a global company preferred. Strong understanding of a global talent attraction

landscape with emphasis on the MX geography

• Ability to learn market and competitive changes quickly, best-in-class search process, including

candidate research and outreach techniques

• Strong knowledge of recruiting-based websites, applicant tracking systems and creative

sourcing techniques. Candidate identification via Boolean/internet searching.

• Experience creating search strategies, mapping markets and gleaning industry insights

• Hands-on research, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills




Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Mexico at the time of hire; limited sponsorship may be available for this role based on business needs and applicable law.




Preferred 

• Experience with some ERP with the Talent acquisition

• Ability to identify candidates for respective industry/service lines, paper screen candidates,

and propose candidates to the recruiter/business




Our people and culture 

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our client most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.




Professional development 

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer

opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through

disabilities. To request a reasonable accommodation, contact our Talent Relations team at

description:
About the job

About Parallel




At Parallel, we believe work is more than just a job—it shapes identity, purpose, and possibility. Our mission is to help people discover their life’s work while enabling organizations to build exceptional teams. We’re creating the next generation of hiring infrastructure, combining AI with thoughtful product design to help people and companies find their best match.




We’re looking for a Technical Product & Project Management Lead to join us on a client engagement, owning both the product strategy/discovery and the execution of a high-impact software project from ideation through delivery. This role sits at the intersection of product management, engineering, design, and client operations—ensuring we build the right features, solve the right user problems, and deliver projects on time and with high quality.




This engagement is expected to continue for the duration of the client project. High-performing team members will also be considered for future client engagements and full-time opportunities within Parallel as we continue to grow.




Role Overview




The Technical Product & Project Management Lead is responsible for driving the full product lifecycle—from user research, feature scoping, and requirements definition to sprint planning, development, QA, launch, and post-release evaluation. You will bridge customer and business needs with technical execution, translating ambiguous client problems into clear product roadmaps and actionable user stories while keeping engineering teams aligned and delivery on schedule.




This role is ideal for a hybrid Product & Project Manager who excels at strategic problem-solving, feature prioritization, cross-functional collaboration, and disciplined project execution in a fast-moving startup environment.




Responsibilities




Product Strategy & Discovery




Define feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specs derived from user research, client feedback, and market needs.
Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, user impact, and technical feasibility.
Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to prototype, validate, and refine user flows and product interactions.
Establish success metrics (KPIs) for product features and analyze post-launch usage data to drive continuous feature iteration.




Execution & Delivery Management




Own the end-to-end delivery of product initiatives from roadmap planning through production release and post-launch optimization.
Create and maintain detailed project plans, roadmaps, release schedules, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
Lead Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Proactively identify product/technical risks, unblock cross-functional dependencies, and drive rapid, informed decision-making.




Stakeholder Management & Operations




Serve as the central point of contact between client stakeholders, executive leadership, design, engineering, and operations teams.
Translate complex customer feedback and business needs into engineering roadmap priorities.
Oversee release management, quality assurance standards, user acceptance testing (UAT), and go-to-market readiness.
Continuously refine product management frameworks, documentation, and delivery processes across the team.




Requirements




3+ years of experience in product management, technical program management, or a hybrid product/project leadership role managing software products.
Proven track record of owning features/products end-to-end: defining user requirements, crafting PRDs (Product Requirement Documents), prioritizing backlogs, and shipping complex SaaS or AI applications.
Strong product sense & UX affinity: Ability to map out intuitive user flows, synthesize complex customer needs, and translate them into simple, powerful product solutions.
Technical & Agile fluency: Deep understanding of software development lifecycles, API integrations, cloud architecture concepts, and modern Agile frameworks.
Data-driven decision making: Experience setting product metrics, conducting quantitative/qualitative analysis, and prioritizing features using ROI framework models (e.g., RICE, MoSCoW).
Exceptional cross-functional leadership: Strong written and verbal communication skills to align engineering, product design, business stakeholders, and clients around a shared vision.
Tool proficiency: Hands-on experience with product and delivery management platforms (e.g., Linear, Jira, Notion, Figma, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Asana).
Startup mindset: Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-ownership environments with evolving priorities.




Nice to Have




Direct experience managing or launching SaaS, AI, or hiring/HR-tech products.
Background as a software engineer, technical writer, or computer science graduate.
Direct client-facing experience in consulting, agency, or enterprise software services environments.
Hands-on experience managing QA automation or complex software release pipelines.




Engagement & Benefits




Contract engagement for the duration of an active client project.
Opportunity to work directly with innovative startups and technology companies on meaningful products.
High-performing contractors will be considered for future client engagements and full-time roles at Parallel.
Competitive compensation.

Colaboramos con más de 300 clientes en más de 40 países y seguimos sumando. Nuestro modelo único impulsa la creatividad y la eficiencia, lo que nos permite ofrecer soluciones personalizadas que impacten profundamente en las audiencias.

Como parte de Brandtech Group, estamos a la vanguardia en el uso de tecnología de inteligencia artificial para revolucionar la forma en que creamos y entregamos nuestro trabajo. Nuestras soluciones de inteligencia artificial mejoran la eficiencia, estimulan la creatividad e impulsan la toma de decisiones acertadas, lo que permite a nuestros equipos producir resultados innovadores e impactantes.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

This is an opportunity to join U-Studio, OLIVER’s award-winning in-house agency for Unilever based in Mexico City with a hybrid working arrangement. You'll be one of the people who makes Dove's social presence happen, day in, day out. From content ideation, trend tracking and scheduling  to community engagement, copy writing, and performance tracking, you'll manage the daily rhythm of Dove's social channels and ensure the brand shows up consistently and compellingly across platforms. 

This is a role for someone who is organized, culturally-fluent, and genuinely enthusiastic about social media as a discipline. You understand what makes content work on TikTok versus Instagram versus YouTube, you can write copy that fits the tone of each platform, and you notice when something is trending before it peaks. We're looking for someone who is as comfortable managing a content calendar and pulling a performance report as they are drafting a reactive post or briefing a content creator on an emerging format. 

Success means channels that run smoothly, content that consistently meets brand and platform standards, a community that feels listened to and engaged, and performance data that shows steady growth in reach, engagement, and brand affinity. 

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

Content Planning and Publishing 

Create and manage Dove's social content calendars across TikTok and Instagramand emerging platforms, ensuring a consistent cadence of planned, campaign, and reactive content 
Schedule and publish content across platforms, ensuring every post meets brand guidelines, platform specifications, and accessibility standards (captions, alt text, format requirements) 
Write and adapt social copy for each platform, ensuring Dove's tone of voice is consistent, compelling, and native to the channel 
Coordinate with the creative team and content creators to ensure assets are delivered on time, correctly formatted, and ready to publish 
Support the Senior Social Media Manager in planning always-on content, campaign activations, and seasonal or product-launch moments 

Community Management and Engagement 

Monitor Dove's social channels daily, responding to comments, messages, and mentions in a timely, on-brand, and thoughtful manner 
Engage proactively with Dove's audience, fostering a sense of community and connection that reflects the brand's values of inclusivity and real beauty 
Track trending topics, hashtags, cultural moments, and platform features, flagging relevant opportunities to the wider team and, where appropriate, drafting reactive content 
Identify opportunities to surprise and delight Dove's audience through creative engagement, timely responses, and community-building moments 

Performance Tracking and Reporting 

Track and report on social content performance across platforms, compiling regular reports on key metrics including reach, engagement, saves, shares, and audience growth 
Use native platform analytics and social management tools to monitor content effectiveness, identify trends, and flag insights that can inform future content decisions 
Support the Senior Social Media Manager and Data Analyst in building a continuous learning loop between content output and performance data 

Collaboration and Coordination 

Collaborate with content creators, designers, and copywriters to ensure social assets align with the content calendar and campaign objectives 
Support the coordination of influencer and creator content within the publishing schedule, ensuring assets are approved, scheduled, and tracked 
Work closely with the Dove brand team on day-to-day social activity, keeping stakeholders informed of what's publishing, what's performing, and what's coming next 
Support briefing processes, helping to translate client briefs and campaign objectives into clear direction for the creative team 

Platform Expertise and Trends 

Stay current with social platform updates, algorithm changes, new features, and emerging content formats, sharing relevant developments with the team 
Contribute ideas for new content formats, series, and engagement approaches based on platform evolution and audience behaviour 
Ensure the studio's content approach reflects the latest platform best practices for organic reach and engagement 

 

WHAT YOU BRING 

3-5 years of experience in social media management for consumer brands, ideally in beauty, personal care, wellness, or FMCG 
Strong platform fluency across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging social channels, including an understanding of content formats, algorithms, audience behaviours, and publishing best practices 
Experience managing social content calendars and publishing workflows across multiple platforms 
Solid copywriting skills, with the ability to write platform-native social copy that reflects a brand's tone of voice and connects with diverse audiences 
Experience with community management, including responding to comments and messages, engaging with audiences, and maintaining a consistent, on-brand presence 
Familiarity with social media management tools (such as Sprinklr, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, or similar) and native platform analytics 
The ability to track and report on social performance metrics, with a good understanding of what the numbers mean and how they inform content decisions 
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing deadlines, and day-to-day publishing demands without losing attention to detail 
A genuine interest in social culture, digital trends, and the evolving beauty and personal care landscape 
A collaborative, proactive working style, with the confidence to flag opportunities, raise issues, and contribute ideas 
Professional proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus 

Gen AI and Agentic Thinking: 

Basic proficiency with Gen AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copy.ai, Grammarly) to support copy drafting, content ideation, trend research, and reporting 
An agentic approach to your work: ability to self-organise, manage priorities, find efficient solutions, and take initiative across a busy, multi-platform workload 
Willingness to experiment with AI tools as part of the social workflow, understanding when they add value and when human creativity, cultural nuance, and community instinct are needed 
Understanding of AI limitations, with an eye for outputs that feel authentic and on-brand versus generic 

Qualifications: 

Formal bachelor´s Degree is a must. 
Must live in Mexico City or metropolitan area. 
Mid Level to advanced Professional proficiency in English, writing and speaking is required. 
Experience working with digital campaigns. 

 

NICE TO HAVE 

Experience working on Dove or Unilever brands 
Experience in an in-house agency, embedded studio, or social-specialist environment 
An editorial background or experience writing long-form and short-form content for social 
Experience working with influencer or creator content within a publishing workflow 
Familiarity with social listening tools and basic audience research 
Experience with accessibility in social publishing (captions, alt text, inclusive content practices) 
An interest in or experience with brand purpose, inclusivity, or social impact in a marketing context 
Familiarity with paid social amplification and how organic and paid content work together

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. Manage multiple tasks simultaneously, determining relative impact and urgency to meet deliverables accurately and on time
Maintain thorough case documentation, updating contact records and keeping stakeholders informed of progress
Identify recurring issues that may impact other partners and escalate to supporting teams to drive systemic resolution
Build working knowledge of products, technologies, and offerings to provide partners with relevant guidance and promote self-service tools
Recommend value-add products, services, and insights that meet partner needs and enhance their platform experience
Learn and propose improvements to processes and procedures to reduce partner effort and improve operational efficiency

Bachelor's degree in a related field; or equivalent related professional experience

description:
About the job

Principal Function: The Order Fulfillment Specialist - Customer Success plays a critical role in efficiently receiving, reviewing, and processing all inbound customer purchase orders. This position ensures seamless coordination between customers, sales and internal teams, facilitates accurate order entry and timely fulfillment, and contributes to maintaining organized, compliant, and accurate internal processes.




Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Duties include, but are not limited to:




1. Customer Order Processing

Receive, review, and validate customer purchase orders to ensure accuracy of pricing, contractual terms, delivery requirements, and compliance with internal policies.
Request and coordinate product allocation, confirm material availability, and enter customer orders accurately into internal systems while monitoring order status through fulfillment.
Proactively track and resolve order delays or discrepancies, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Success teams to align on delivery timelines and customer expectations.
Generate and distribute sales order confirmations to customers, ensuring clear communication of order details and fulfillment milestones.
Document, verify, and maintain records of any applicable third-party broker commissions associated with customer orders, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.

2. Customer Outbound Logistics

Plan, select, and execute all outbound customer shipments, balancing, cost efficiency, service reliability, and customer-specific delivery requirements.
Monitor shipment progress from dispatch through final delivery, providing timely, proactive updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with freight brokers, carriers, and warehouse partners to schedule shipments, resolve transit issues, mitigate delays, develop contingency plans to minimize customer impact.
Identify recurring logistics challenges and contribute to continuous improvement efforts aimed at enhancing delivery performance, visibility, and overall customer satisfaction.

3. Customer Support

Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and a solutions-oriented approach that reinforces thrust and long-term partnership.
Act as an extension of the Sales team by supporting customer requests, identifying upsell or follow-on order opportunities, and ensuring seamless handoffs between Sales and Operations.
Communicate extensively with customers, carriers, brokers, and internal teams via high-volume email and time-sensitive phone calls, responding promptly to inquiries, issues, and escalation needs related to active orders and shipments.
Prepare, retrieve, and distribute customer-requested documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates, and shipping records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

4. Other

Carry out other duties to support departmental and organizational objectives.




Supervisory Responsibilities: This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty according to the requirements of the Company. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities.




Company-Related Competencies: To perform their jobs successfully, all employees working in the St. Louis Group should demonstrate the following competencies:

· Ethics – Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works ethically and with integrity; Upholds Company values.

· Professionalism – Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for personal actions; Follows through on commitments.

· Problem Solving – Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

· Written and Oral Communication – Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; Listens and obtains clarification; Responds well to questions; Demonstrates group presentation skills; Participates in meetings; Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Reads with the ability to interpret written information.

· Teamwork – Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others’ views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone’s efforts to succeed.

· Adaptability – Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.




Job-Related Competencies – To perform this job successfully, employees in this job should demonstrate the following competencies:

· Quality and Quantity – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality; Meets productivity standards; Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly but efficiently.

· Customer Service – Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.

· Dependability – Follows instructions; Responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Keeps commitments; Commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan.

· Organizational Support – Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization’s goals and values; Benefits organization through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.

· Attendance/Punctuality – Is consistently at work and is on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time.




Education and/or Experience: Bachelor's Degree and two-years related experience and/or training in an corporate office setting; or equivalent combination of education and experience.




Other Skills and Abilities: The following skills and abilities are either required or desired.

· Computer software skills including: Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel), Adobe, and Slack messaging software are required. The ability to quickly adapt and embrace new software is required.

· The ability to develop positive working relationships and interact effectively with vendors, brokers, customers, and colleagues is required.

· The ability to effectively listen and communicate orally and in writing is required.

· The ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously is required.

· The ability to prepare reports and forms is required.

· The ability to follow all established protocols, guidelines, and departmental policies is required.

· The ability to work alone with minimum supervision and with others in a team environment is required.

· The ability to work rapidly for long periods, under time pressure, and on several tasks at the same time is required.

· The ability to remain calm, perform duties, and make sound and rational decisions, including exercising independent judgment within established protocols and guidelines is required.

· The ability to be sensitive to professional ethics, gender, cultural diversities and disabilities is required.




· A working knowledge of standard office practices and the ability to apply such knowledge to a variety of interrelated processes, tasks, and operations is required.

· The ability to operate a computer, printer, telephone/switchboard, calculator, postage meter, copy machine, scanner, fax machine, shredder, and other office equipment is required.

· The ability to speak, read and write in English is required. Spanish is desired.

· The ability to occasionally travel out-of-town on Company-related business and/or to attend conferences and trainings, is desired.




Work Environment: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties and responsibilities. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to the risk of electrical shock when working with the St. Louis Group office equipment. About the job

Ready to take your career global?

Great customer experiences start with quality. As a Quality Control Specialist at Global Payments, you’ll play an important role in ensuring every interaction reflects the high standards our clients and cardholders expect. Your insights will help strengthen service quality, improve performance and create better outcomes for customers around the world.

What You’ll Own


 Drive service excellence by evaluating customer interactions against client defined quality standards and identifying opportunities to improve the customer experience.
 Deliver meaningful feedback that strengthens Customer Service Representative performance and contributes to higher quality outcomes for cardholders.
 Create visibility into quality trends by maintaining accurate scoring, reporting and performance tracking that informs business decisions.
 Influence continuous improvement by identifying recurring themes and opportunities that enhance service consistency and client satisfaction.
 Build strong partnerships with customer service teams to encourage quality focused behaviors and reinforce best practices.
 Contribute to client confidence by ensuring quality reviews are completed accurately, consistently and in line with established requirements.
 Strengthen operational effectiveness by supporting quality initiatives, reporting activities and process improvements that drive measurable results.
 Maintain service continuity by stepping in to address customer inquiries when needed, ensuring a positive and seamless experience.


What You Bring


 High school diploma or equivalent.
 Strong attention to detail with the ability to evaluate information accurately and consistently.
 Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to provide constructive feedback.
A customer focused mindset and a passion for delivering high quality experiences.
 Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage priorities while maintaining accuracy.
 Comfort working with business systems, reporting tools and standard computer applications.
 A collaborative approach and willingness to learn, grow and contribute as part of a team.


It’s a bonus if you have


 One to two years of experience in quality assurance, customer service, contact center operations or a related field.
 Knowledge of the Chile line of business and customer service environment.
 Experience analyzing performance trends and using data to identify opportunities for service improvement.


About The Team

You’ll join a collaborative team where learning, development and continuous improvement are part of everyday work. Working closely with customer service teams and quality professionals, you’ll gain valuable experience, develop your expertise and contribute to a culture focused on excellence and accountability.

In this role, you’ll create opportunities to improve customer experiences, influence service quality through meaningful feedback and own the accuracy of quality evaluations that drive performance improvements. Your work will help strengthen client confidence, elevate service standards and support the future of commerce through exceptional customer interactions.

Our Perks - What We’ll Bring For You

We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life, and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.

A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution

Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business

Access to learning, development and on-the-job experiences that expand your expertise

A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter

Time to give back through community and charity initiatives

A global employee assistance programme to support your wellbeing

Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative — always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

Global Payments is an organization that stands against racism, intolerance and injustice in all its forms — one that respects, honors and celebrates the diversity of our team members and the differences among us. Our commitment to fostering a company culture that values and respects Inclusion and Diversity is steadfast. Standing together as one company, we will continue to work to drive positive change for the communities in which we live and work and stamp out injustice.

About the job

Job Description

Serve as the primary customer contact for your assigned portfolio of accounts and ensure all customer needs and expectations are met. You will respond to inbound customer calls and email regarding order inquiry as to ship dates, problems, order changes, repairs and RMA's. You will assist other customer service associates with administrative duties. You will communicate with other departments such as Technical Support, Logistics, Manufacturing, Regional Sales Managers, Product Managers, etc. , to resolve customer issues. You will support ordering processing including order entry, expediting orders, change orders, returns, monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies. Help ADI be the customer's top choice by delivering excellent customer care. Build up your business acumen while learning to address customer needs. Be part of the team that is solving complex problems for the customer.

JOB DUTIES:


Independently processes routine sales support requests, including order entry, updates, and record maintenance, with minimal guidance.
Tracks order status and coordinates follow-up on shipping dates, lead times, and basic order changes within established procedures.
Responds to standard customer and internal inquiries by phone or email, using approved information and company systems.
Troubleshoots routine issues such as missing information, basic order discrepancies, and simple documentation errors, escalating unusual cases when needed.
Coordinates with sales, customer service, operations, and other internal teams to help resolve routine order or fulfillment questions.
Maintains accurate logs, customer notes, and transaction records to support timely service and clean handoffs.
Guides newer team members informally on basic processes, system usage, and documentation expectations.
Identifies recurring process issues and shares suggestions to improve day-to-day accuracy and workflow consistency.


YOU MUST HAVE:


1-2 years of customer service or support experience, with the ability to independently manage customer requests from start to finish.
Advanced English communication skills (written and verbal), including professional email correspondence and customer interactions.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through, ensuring accurate responses, proper documentation, and timely follow-up.
Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to anticipating customer needs and resolving issues.
Team-oriented mindset and ability to follow established processes (SOPs) while maintaining professionalism and accountability.


WE VALUE:


An ability to learn quickly
Ability to multitask
Being proactive
A bias for action
An ability to work in a team
A commitment to discovering ways to improve service
Professionalism
Emotional intelligence


WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?


Benefits that go beyond Mexican labor law, ensuring your well-being and peace of mind.
A collaborative and inclusive work environment where your contributions are valued.
Opportunities for continuous professional growth and skill development through training, mentoring, and challenging projects.
Access to cutting-edge tools, resources, and a supportive team to help you excel.
The chance to work with a global, innovative company shaping the future in its industry.


About Us

ADI is a leading global distributor and solutions provider of security, AV, and smart living technologies, helping professionals deliver smarter, safer, and more connected experiences for homes and businesses around the world. Through trusted brands, exclusive solutions, and strong industry partnerships, ADI supports more than 110,000 customers across residential and commercial markets globally. From security and video surveillance to networking, audio, automation, fire, and connected technologies, ADI offers a broad portfolio of products, services, and software designed to support the evolving needs of integrators, installers, and technology professionals. With a global team spanning operations, sales, supply chain, digital, customer experience, engineering, and more, ADI combines deep industry expertise with innovation and service to help customers grow and succeed in an evolving industry. At ADI, our teams help create the technologies, partnerships, and experiences that keep people connected, protected, and supported every day. Learn more at www.adiglobal.com .

description:
About the job

Senior Sales Executive – Experiential Marketing & Fabrication (Remote)Company Description

Vukler Studio is a custom fabrication and experiential production studio that transforms creative concepts into high-impact physical experiences. We specialize in custom sets, props, installations, branded environments, event activations, and large-scale fabrication for agencies, brands, production companies, entertainment, and live events.

Our team combines creative problem-solving, advanced fabrication techniques, and traditional craftsmanship to bring ambitious concepts to life. From initial design and engineering through fabrication and delivery, Vukler Studio works closely with clients to create visually compelling, durable, and memorable experiences.

Role Description

Vukler Studio is seeking an experienced Senior Sales Executive to generate new business and expand our client network.

This is a fully remote position, and candidates may be located anywhere in the world. The primary focus of this role is business development within the U.S. market, particularly with experiential marketing agencies, event agencies, production companies, creative agencies, brands, exhibit companies, and other organizations requiring custom fabrication.

This is an outbound sales-focused position. We are looking for someone who knows how to identify opportunities, reach decision-makers, build relationships, and convert those relationships into qualified projects and long-term clients.

Key Responsibilities
Identify and prospect new potential clients throughout the U.S.
Conduct outbound outreach through phone calls, email, LinkedIn, and other sales channels.
Build relationships with experiential agencies, event producers, creative agencies, production companies, brands, exhibit companies, and other potential partners.
Identify upcoming activations, events, installations, campaigns, and fabrication opportunities.
Generate qualified leads and bring new RFQs, RFPs, and project opportunities to Vukler Studio.
Present Vukler Studio's capabilities, portfolio, and fabrication services to prospective clients.
Understand client requirements and coordinate with our estimating, design, and production teams to develop proposals.
Follow up consistently on estimates, proposals, and open opportunities.
Negotiate and close projects while maintaining strong client relationships.
Maintain an organized sales pipeline and accurately track leads, opportunities, follow-ups, and results.
Develop long-term relationships that generate repeat projects and referrals.
Research new agencies, brands, markets, and potential strategic partners.
Qualifications
Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, and new client acquisition.
Strong preference for candidates with experience in experiential marketing, event production, custom fabrication, exhibits, trade shows, scenic fabrication, sets and props, branded environments, or related creative industries.
Demonstrated ability to generate new business through outbound prospecting rather than relying solely on inbound leads.
Strong cold-calling, cold-emailing, LinkedIn prospecting, and follow-up skills.
Experience communicating and selling to agencies, producers, marketing teams, creative directors, brand managers, and other decision-makers.
Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to understand custom, project-based services where every project may have different specifications, budgets, and timelines.
Ability to manage multiple sales opportunities simultaneously and maintain consistent follow-up.
Experience using CRM and sales prospecting tools.
Strong written and spoken English.
Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Ability to work hours that provide reasonable overlap with U.S. business hours.
Location

Remote – Worldwide

Candidates do not need to be located in the United States. We welcome experienced sales professionals from anywhere in the world who can successfully develop relationships and generate business within the U.S. market.

Ideal Candidate

We are particularly interested in candidates who already understand the experiential marketing, event production, and custom fabrication industries and ideally have an existing network of agencies, producers, brands, or other potential clients.

The ideal candidate is proactive, persistent, highly organized, and results-driven. You should be comfortable opening doors, reaching new decision-makers, developing relationships from scratch, and turning those relationships into real project opportunities.

This is an opportunity to represent a growing fabrication studio capable of executing unique, creative, and large-scale projects for clients throughout the United States.

La Oportunidad

El Strategic Merchandising Coordinator tendrá a su cargo la implementación, armonización y escalamiento de soluciones de exhibición en mercados clave como Brasil, SoCo y México, en línea con las estrategias de Perfect Store, Shopper Marketing y Digital Transformation. Es un rol que exige equilibrio entre el criterio técnico y la visión estratégica: traducir necesidades locales en soluciones replicables a nivel regional, con foco en eficiencia, calidad, sustentabilidad y digitalización.

Tu impacto

Como Merchandising Coodinator tus responsabilidades constarían de…

Liderar la implementación de exhibiciones alineadas a los objetivos estratégicos de cada país, sirviendo como punto de conexión directo con los equipos locales de Merchandising, Perfect Store, Shopper Marketing y Marketing para alinear prioridades y aterrizar necesidades estratégicas y comerciales del mercado.

Asegurar que tanto las agendas TEMP como PERM se integren dentro del catálogo digital LATAM, impulsando la homologación de procesos, ingenierías y materiales entre países. Esto incluye coordinar con proveedores locales para que la producción se ejecute sin desviaciones respecto a las ingenierías liberadas, y participar en los entrenamientos y la liberación de prototipos validando estándares de calidad.

Impulsar iniciativas de sustentabilidad, con énfasis en la reducción de la huella de carbono en los exhibidores, y colaborar en la evolución del proceso WCCE junto a los equipos de Customer Engagement y CCO.

Representar al equipo de DX Merchandising en foros transversales con áreas como Digital Transformation, Procurement y GBS, entre otras.


Porcentaje de soluciones armonizadas y estandarizadas por canal y país. 
Incremento en productividad y cobertura a través de modelos escalables. 
Reducción de la huella de carbono en exhibidores. 
Nivel de adopción del catálogo digital regional por parte de los países. 
Avances en los procesos WCCE vinculados a Perfect 10 (showroom virtual, realidades extendidas). 
Satisfacción y nivel de alineación con los equipos locales de Brasil y SoCo. 


Qualifications

¿A quién buscamos?


Formación en diseño industrial, arquitectura, ingeniería o carreras afines, con experiencia comprobable en la implementación de soluciones físicas en entornos de retail. Buscamos a alguien con sólida capacidad de gestión transversal y trabajo colaborativo, que se mueva con comodidad entre equipos y geografías.
En lo técnico, es importante el conocimiento de materiales, procesos de fabricación y homologación. En lo estratégico, una visión orientada a la eficiencia, la sustentabilidad y la escalabilidad. Se requieren excelentes habilidades de comunicación, análisis y negociación, tanto en español como en inglés; cualquier idioma adicional es un plus. La experiencia previa en ambientes multiculturales o regionales será un diferenciador. 


Si esta es una oportunidad que te interesa, te alentamos a postularte aún si no cumples con el 100% de los requisitos.

Lo que puedes esperar de nosotros:


Oportunidades para aprender y desarrollarte todos los días a través de una amplia oferta de programas. 
Plataformas internas digitales que promueven el self-learning. 
Programas de desarrollo de acuerdo con habilidades de Liderazgo. 
Entrenamientos especializados de acuerdo con el rol. 
Experiencias de aprendizaje con proveedores internos y externos. 
Nos encanta celebrar el éxito, por lo que contamos con programas de reconocimiento por antigüedad, comportamientos, liderazgo, momentos de vida, entre otros. 
Programas de bienestar financiero que te ayudarán a alcanzar tus metas en todas las etapas de la vida. 
Un programa de flexibilidad que te permitirá balancear tu vida personal y laboral, adaptando tu jornada laboral a tu estilo de vida. 
Y porque tu familia también es importante para nosotros, ellos también pueden gozar de beneficios como nuestra Línea de Bienestar, miles de Convenios y Descuentos, programas de Becas para tus hijos, Planes de Ayuda para diferentes momentos de vida, entre otros. 


En PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos con impulsar un equipo de trabajo diverso al crear un espacio colaborativo, equitativo e incluyente, en donde todos y todas independientemente de cómo nos vemos, de dónde somos o a quién amamos- tengamos una voz. Ofrecemos oportunidades únicas para contratar personas calificadas y diversas, independientemente de su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, edad o discapacidad.

description:
About the job

Comparte tu experiencia e impulsa a la próxima generación de emprendedores

¿Has construido una comunidad en redes sociales? ¿Has desarrollado estrategias digitales para marcas o proyectos? ¿Te apasiona compartir conocimiento y enseñar desde la experiencia?

En Liberu estamos desarrollando un programa de capacitación dirigido a emprendedores del sector de alimentos que buscan fortalecer su presencia en redes sociales, conectar con nuevos clientes y hacer crecer su negocio mediante estrategias digitales.

Para ello, buscamos especialistas con experiencia comprobada que deseen impartir workshops prácticos, dinámicos y basados en casos reales.







¿Qué tipo de perfiles buscamos?

Estamos en búsqueda de profesionales con experiencia comprobable en alguna de las siguientes áreas:

Social Media Management
Planeación Digital
Marketing Digital
Branding Digital
Creación de Contenido
Influencer Marketing
Community Management
Producción de Contenido

También invitamos a postularse a creadores de contenido que hayan desarrollado comunidades sólidas y deseen compartir su experiencia.







¿Qué buscamos en un speaker?

Más allá de la experiencia profesional, buscamos personas capaces de enseñar de forma clara, cercana y práctica.

Valoraremos especialmente perfiles que:

Disfruten compartir conocimiento.
Expliquen conceptos de manera sencilla.
Enseñen a partir de experiencias reales.
Tengan facilidad para hablar frente a grupos.
Inspiren a emprendedores y pequeños negocios.
Promuevan el aprendizaje mediante ejercicios y ejemplos prácticos.

Nuestro objetivo no es ofrecer clases teóricas, sino talleres que permitan a los participantes aplicar lo aprendido desde el primer día.







Programa de capacitación

El programa estará conformado por cuatro módulos, distribuidos durante dos semanas.

Cada speaker será seleccionado para impartir uno de los siguientes módulos.

Módulo 1Fundamentos de las Redes Sociales para Negocios

Temas de referencia:

Importancia de las redes sociales para un negocio.
Diferencias entre plataformas.
Errores comunes.
Casos de éxito.
Buenas prácticas.







Módulo 2Estrategia de Contenido para Negocios

Temas de referencia:

Definición de objetivos.
Conocimiento del cliente.
Planeación de contenido.
Calendario editorial.
Organización de publicaciones.







Módulo 3Creación de Contenido para Redes Sociales

Temas de referencia:

Desarrollo de ideas.
Grabación con celular.
Producción de contenido.
Comunicación frente a cámara.
Casos reales y aprendizajes.







Módulo 4Cómo convertir el contenido en resultados para el negocio

Temas de referencia:

Interpretación de métricas.
Optimización del contenido.
Gestión de comunidad.
Mejores prácticas.
Planes de mejora.

Contar con una comunidad mínima de 50,000 seguidores en alguna de sus principales plataformas (Instagram, TikTok o YouTube).
Poder compartir casos reales sobre cómo construyeron y desarrollaron su comunidad.
Para perfiles estratégicos
Experiencia comprobable desarrollando estrategias digitales para marcas, empresas o proyectos.
Haber liderado iniciativas relacionadas con marketing digital o gestión de redes sociales.
Para todos los perfiles
Excelente capacidad de comunicación.
Disponibilidad para impartir sesiones de capacitación en línea.
Interés por compartir conocimiento con emprendedores.

Proceso de selección1. Recepción de postulaciones

Revisaremos la experiencia profesional, trayectoria y propuesta preliminar de cada candidato.

2. Entrevista con Liberu

Los perfiles preseleccionados participarán en una videollamada para conocer su experiencia, metodología de enseñanza y estilo de comunicación.

3. Desarrollo de la propuesta final

Los speakers seleccionados trabajarán junto con el equipo de Liberu para desarrollar y adaptar el contenido definitivo de su workshop, alineándolo con los objetivos del programa.

4. Selección final

Se confirmarán los especialistas que impartirán cada uno de los módulos del programa.







¿Por qué participar?
Compartir tu experiencia con emprendedores que buscan hacer crecer sus negocios.
