En PepsiCo, descubrirás un lugar donde nuestra misión es crear sonrisas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 500 marcas queridas, incluyen Gatorade, Lay's y Quaker y nuestro trabajo llega a millones de personas cada día.

En el corazón de nuestra compañía hay un equipo de pensadores y creadores que colaboran para innovar y convertir las ideas en acciones. Impulsados por la innovación y centrados en crear momentos de alegría a través de los alimentos y bebidas, nuestras decisiones se guían por y para el consumidor, creando oportunidades para que nuestros asociados realicen un trabajo significativo y tengan un impacto duradero en las comunidades a las que servimos.

Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea.

Responsibilities

La Oportunidad

El Strategic Merchandising Coordinator tendrá a su cargo la implementación, armonización y escalamiento de soluciones de exhibición en mercados clave como Brasil, SoCo y México, en línea con las estrategias de Perfect Store, Shopper Marketing y Digital Transformation. Es un rol que exige equilibrio entre el criterio técnico y la visión estratégica: traducir necesidades locales en soluciones replicables a nivel regional, con foco en eficiencia, calidad, sustentabilidad y digitalización.

Tu impacto

Como Merchandising Coodinator tus responsabilidades constarían de…

Liderar la implementación de exhibiciones alineadas a los objetivos estratégicos de cada país, sirviendo como punto de conexión directo con los equipos locales de Merchandising, Perfect Store, Shopper Marketing y Marketing para alinear prioridades y aterrizar necesidades estratégicas y comerciales del mercado.

Asegurar que tanto las agendas TEMP como PERM se integren dentro del catálogo digital LATAM, impulsando la homologación de procesos, ingenierías y materiales entre países. Esto incluye coordinar con proveedores locales para que la producción se ejecute sin desviaciones respecto a las ingenierías liberadas, y participar en los entrenamientos y la liberación de prototipos validando estándares de calidad.

Impulsar iniciativas de sustentabilidad, con énfasis en la reducción de la huella de carbono en los exhibidores, y colaborar en la evolución del proceso WCCE junto a los equipos de Customer Engagement y CCO.

Representar al equipo de DX Merchandising en foros transversales con áreas como Digital Transformation, Procurement y GBS, entre otras.


Porcentaje de soluciones armonizadas y estandarizadas por canal y país. 
Incremento en productividad y cobertura a través de modelos escalables. 
Reducción de la huella de carbono en exhibidores. 
Nivel de adopción del catálogo digital regional por parte de los países. 
Avances en los procesos WCCE vinculados a Perfect 10 (showroom virtual, realidades extendidas). 
Satisfacción y nivel de alineación con los equipos locales de Brasil y SoCo. 


Qualifications

¿A quién buscamos?


Formación en diseño industrial, arquitectura, ingeniería o carreras afines, con experiencia comprobable en la implementación de soluciones físicas en entornos de retail. Buscamos a alguien con sólida capacidad de gestión transversal y trabajo colaborativo, que se mueva con comodidad entre equipos y geografías.
En lo técnico, es importante el conocimiento de materiales, procesos de fabricación y homologación. En lo estratégico, una visión orientada a la eficiencia, la sustentabilidad y la escalabilidad. Se requieren excelentes habilidades de comunicación, análisis y negociación, tanto en español como en inglés; cualquier idioma adicional es un plus. La experiencia previa en ambientes multiculturales o regionales será un diferenciador. 


Si esta es una oportunidad que te interesa, te alentamos a postularte aún si no cumples con el 100% de los requisitos.

Lo que puedes esperar de nosotros:


Oportunidades para aprender y desarrollarte todos los días a través de una amplia oferta de programas. 
Plataformas internas digitales que promueven el self-learning. 
Programas de desarrollo de acuerdo con habilidades de Liderazgo. 
Entrenamientos especializados de acuerdo con el rol. 
Experiencias de aprendizaje con proveedores internos y externos. 
Nos encanta celebrar el éxito, por lo que contamos con programas de reconocimiento por antigüedad, comportamientos, liderazgo, momentos de vida, entre otros. 
Programas de bienestar financiero que te ayudarán a alcanzar tus metas en todas las etapas de la vida. 
Un programa de flexibilidad que te permitirá balancear tu vida personal y laboral, adaptando tu jornada laboral a tu estilo de vida. 
Y porque tu familia también es importante para nosotros, ellos también pueden gozar de beneficios como nuestra Línea de Bienestar, miles de Convenios y Descuentos, programas de Becas para tus hijos, Planes de Ayuda para diferentes momentos de vida, entre otros. 


En PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos con impulsar un equipo de trabajo diverso al crear un espacio colaborativo, equitativo e incluyente, en donde todos y todas independientemente de cómo nos vemos, de dónde somos o a quién amamos- tengamos una voz. Ofrecemos oportunidades únicas para contratar personas calificadas y diversas, independientemente de su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, edad o discapacidad.

Reuters Events is seeking a commercially minded and data-driven Jr. Marketing Manager to lead the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across a portfolio of global conferences and content products. The Jr. Marketing Manager will work cross-functionally with product, sales, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver high-impact, multi-channel campaigns that support business growth and strengthen Reuters Events' market presence.

Identify and implement innovative ways to reach senior executive audiences across key industry sectors.
Build and manage channel, media, and marketing partnerships to support event promotion and customer acquisition.
Plan and deliver multi-channel campaigns across email, web, content, paid media, partnerships, and social channels.
Monitor, analyse, and optimize campaign performance using tools such as Google Analytics and Salesforce.
Track key marketing KPIs and provide regular reporting and insight to stakeholders.

About You

Preferred Experience


Experience marketing to senior executive or C-level audiences.
Experience working with external partners, media partners, or agencies.
Understanding of lead generation and customer acquisition strategies in a B2B environment.


What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. title: AI Creative Account Manager
skills: Own client confidence and satisfaction, using AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working, not an afterthought. Build trusted relationships and communicate before clients need to follow up.

Understand each client's strategy, stakeholders, services, commercial context, audience, creative vision, preferences, and pressure points well enough to represent the account internally and anticipate needs.

Turn the client's creative vision into action across briefs, content calendars, campaigns, and deliverables. Review creative assets critically and give clear feedback that protects the intent while improving the work.
Work out what the client is asking for, what they may really need, and what matters strategically. Turn ambiguity into clear direction, context, owners, dependencies, decisions, and next steps.

Keep delivery coordinated across services, teams, timelines, blockers, and dependencies. Use agents and reusable workflows for preparation, action tracking, planning, research, reporting, and follow-up.

Bring strong account judgment to ambiguous work. Balance the relationship, delivery reality, commercial context, capacity, risk, and long-term account health. Diagnose issues first, then escalate with evidence, options, and a recommendation.

Protect the quality and value of Storm's creative, operational, strategic, and technical services. Challenge work that is weak, off-strategy, unsuitable for the platform, or unlikely to create the intended value, and help get it to the right standard.

Make account health and commitments visible. Surface sentiment, risks, opportunities, scope pressure, decisions, approvals, and follow-ups early, with records that people and agents can pick up and use.
Connect clients with Storm's wider expertise so they experience the depth and connected value of the team.
Spot and develop opportunities from client needs, service gaps, relationship signals, campaign moments, or operational problems, bringing enough evidence and context for the right people to act.

Improve how each account runs through better communication rhythms, reporting, documentation, approved AI workflows, and blocker framing. Coach teammates to bring evidence, what they have tried, options, and a specific ask.
Stay current in account management, social platforms, creative work, and the services around the role. Apply feedback and keep improving the quality, speed, judgment, and reliability of your work.

Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you.
Evidence that you can own client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.

Strong creative and social judgment. You can translate a client's vision into briefs, recognize platform-native ideas, explain why an asset works or does not, and give constructive feedback across copy, design, and video.

Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools and agents in real work, studies, or personal projects: research, meeting preparation, context management, drafting, analysis, action tracking, QA, or workflow improvement, not just quick questions or meeting note summaries.
The judgment to review AI output against client strategy, service quality, commercial context, facts, commitments, and brand standards. You never treat it as finished work.
A systems thinker: you see repeatable account work as a workflow to design and improve, not a list of tasks to grind through.
High agency and ownership. You step beyond the immediate brief, drive improvements to completion, and know when to escalate early.
Commercial awareness and the ability to recognize scope pressure, service gaps, account risk, and useful growth opportunities.
Operational, strategic, and technical curiosity. You understand the work around the creative, ask sharper questions, challenge weak assumptions, and explain tradeoffs plainly.
Comfort with collaborative systems such as Airtable, Monday.com, Notion, Asana, spreadsheets, Slack, Teams, or similar tools, plus an appetite to improve them.
Clear written and spoken communication. You make messy situations feel calm and practical and work well asynchronously.
Attention to detail held at speed: names, dates, decisions, dependencies, status, and promises stay accurate.
Enthusiasm for how quickly AI-enabled knowledge work is evolving, with an instinct for what improves client work and what is just noise.
Answer a short set of self-recorded video questions.
Meet with Account Management leadership or our recruitment team.

Complete a short, time-boxed practical task built around a realistic client and creative brief. We'll ask you to assess the work, explain your feedback, and show how you used AI. Your method interests us as much as your output.
Meet with a senior leader for a second interview and discussion of your approach.

Who We Are 




At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.




Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.




Embracing Future-Facing Technology 




Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!




About The Role 




We are hiring an Account Manager to grow client confidence, satisfaction, and account value. Our client portfolio includes some of the biggest names in global entertainment, including well-known animation brands, so this role will particularly suit someone who is excited by fandoms and understands why audiences care deeply about particular characters, stories, and worlds. You will combine relationship ownership, commercial awareness, and creative confidence to turn each client's vision into strong social work.




Creative confidence is central. You will not make every asset, but you must translate the client's vision, know what works and what does not on social, and review copy, design, and video with specific feedback the team can act on.

This is not a message-passing role. You will represent the client internally, engage with the quality and value of the work, bring structure to ambiguity, challenge weak scope, and make sure clients know what happens next.




Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.

We're not talking about using AI as a search box or an autocomplete. The person we're looking for treats AI as a capable pair of hands. They delegate whole pieces of work, not just questions. They review what comes back with a sharp, critical eye. And they keep refining how they brief and direct it, so the quality compounds. If you read that and thought "that's just how I work now," this role is built for you.




You'll learn your assigned account deeply: its strategy, services, relationships, commercial context, and the standard the work must meet. From there, you'll use Storm's AI and collaborative tools as part of how you plan, prepare, communicate, coordinate delivery, and follow through. The role remains account management at its core: building trusted relationships, exercising strong judgement, protecting the quality and value of the work, and helping accounts grow.

Evidence that you can own client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.

Enthusiasm for how quickly AI-enabled knowledge work is evolving, with an instinct for what improves client work and what is just noise.




What It's Like To Work Here




Modern Tools & A Real AI Stack

You will have modern hardware, approved AI tools, collaboration systems, and support from our AI Operations team. We expect you to use that stack seriously in real work.




Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works

We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.




Team-Based

You will work with an international team of 175+ people across account management, strategy, creative, production, operations, AI, and technology. The best client experience makes that expertise feel connected.




Remote-First & Pacific-Time Aligned

This role is fully remote, but it works Pacific Time hours, generally 9:00am–5:30 pm PT.

Apply through our careers site. Any work you want to show us? It's optional but would be a bonus! Anything you think might be relevant.

Together, WE enable individuals to look, feel, and be their true selves.

For additional information about the Wella Company please visit www.wellacompany.com.

We are looking for a highly driven, analytical, and execution-oriented Trade Marketing Associate Manager to join our Professional Beauty team in Mexico.

This role is responsible for developing and executing trade marketing strategies that accelerate sustainable growth, strengthen brand presence, and improve commercial performance across direct customers, distributors, and key professional beauty channels.

The Associate Manager will act as a key link between Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams, translating brand and commercial priorities into effective customer and channel plans. Knowledge of demand planning, forecasting, inventory management, or sales and operations planning processes.

description:
About the job

Fundada en 2004, OLIVER es la primera y única empresa del mundo especializada en diseñar, crear y gestionar agencias y ecosistemas de marketing internos a medida con el modelo inhouse para distintas marcas. Colaboramos con más de 300 clientes en más de 40 países y seguimos sumando. Nuestro modelo único impulsa la creatividad y la eficiencia, lo que nos permite ofrecer soluciones personalizadas que impacten profundamente en las audiencias.

Como parte de Brandtech Group, estamos a la vanguardia en el uso de tecnología de inteligencia artificial para revolucionar la forma en que creamos y entregamos nuestro trabajo. Nuestras soluciones de inteligencia artificial mejoran la eficiencia, estimulan la creatividad e impulsan la toma de decisiones acertadas, lo que permite a nuestros equipos producir resultados innovadores e impactantes.

 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

This is an opportunity to join U-Studio, OLIVER’s award-winning in-house agency for Unilever, as Influencer Manager, leading local social creative and helping the brand show up with relevance, consistency, and craft in-market. 

Based in Mexico City with a hybrid working arrangement, you will lead the local studio’s creative output across always-on content, campaign adaptations, and market-led moments. Your platform-first creative direction will turn global guidance into work that feels made for local audiences and delivers against brand and business goals. 
We support flexible working and are open to different arrangements. 
THE ROLE 

You'll be the person who connects Dove with the creators who bring its brand to life in the most authentic, relatable way across social. This is a multi-faceted role that blends influencer strategy, relationship management, creative thinking, and project management. You'll develop and manage the creator community end to end, shaping how Dove partners with influencers and content creators to drive reach, engagement, and genuine advocacy. 

Dove's relationship with creators is different from most beauty brands. The people who represent us need to genuinely reflect the diversity, honesty, and purpose the brand stands for. We're looking for someone who understands that influencer marketing for Dove isn't about reach alone. It's about finding and partnering with creators whose audiences trust them, whose content feels real, and whose values align with Dove's commitment to inclusive beauty and self-esteem. 

Success means a thriving, well-managed creator community that delivers consistent, high-quality content, a programme that scales across markets, and influencer partnerships that feel as authentic to audiences as they do to the creators themselves. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

Creator Identification and Recruitment 

Identify, contact, and recruit creators on an ongoing basis, building a diverse community of influencers who authentically represent Dove's brand values and resonate with target audiences across platforms
Evaluate potential creator partners based on audience relevance, content quality, engagement authenticity, brand alignment, and representation of diverse beauty
Maintain and manage a structured creator database, tracking tiers, content output, performance, and relationship status

Community Management and Engagement 

Develop and manage Dove's creator engagement programme, building genuine, long-term relationships with influencers rather than transactional, campaign-by-campaign partnerships
Manage ongoing communication and dialogue with the creator community, ensuring creators feel valued, informed, and connected to Dove's brand purpose
Create and distribute regular community communications, such as newsletters, updates, and exclusive content
Organise and support creator events, focus groups, and community moments that deepen relationships and generate insight
Ideate and produce creative product mailers and gifting activations that surprise and engage creators in ways that feel personal and on-brand

Campaign and Content Activation 

Brief and manage creators for campaign activations, always-on content, product launches, and cultural moments, ensuring deliverables are on time, on brand, and aligned with platform best practices
Develop creative briefs for influencer content that give creators clear direction while leaving room for authentic, platform-native expression
Coordinate with the creative and social teams to ensure influencer content is integrated into broader content calendars and campaign plans
Track and record all creator content, ensuring proper usage rights, approvals, and compliance with advertising and disclosure regulations

Performance and Reporting 

Report on influencer campaign performance, community growth, engagement metrics, and programme impact, using data to refine strategy and demonstrate value
Monitor creator content quality and audience response, identifying what's working and feeding learnings back into briefs and strategy
Track programme operations including newsletter engagement, event participation, and community health metrics

Programme Development and Scaling 

Shape and refine the creator programme's processes, tools, and ways of working, building a model that is efficient, scalable, and replicable
Support the expansion of Dove's creator programme into additional markets, adapting the approach for different regions, platforms, and audiences
Contribute to the wider studio's influencer strategy, sharing best practices and insights that raise the standard across the team

Client Partnership 

Partner with the Dove brand team on influencer strategy, presenting programme updates, campaign results, and recommendations with clarity and confidence
Manage client feedback and approvals within the influencer workflow, keeping stakeholders informed and the process running smoothly

 

WHAT YOU BRING 

3-5 years of experience in influencer marketing or creator management, with a focus on consumer brands, ideally in beauty, personal care, wellness, or FMCG
A proven track record of identifying, recruiting, briefing, and managing influencers and content creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms
Experience building and maintaining ongoing creator communities or ambassador programmes, not just one-off campaign activations
Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple creator relationships, campaigns, and workstreams simultaneously without dropping detail
An understanding of influencer contracts, usage rights, disclosure regulations, and compliance requirements
Creative thinking, with the ability to develop engaging briefs, gifting concepts, event ideas, and community activations that strengthen creator relationships
Confidence presenting to and partnering with brand clients, with clear and structured communication skills
Experience using influencer management platforms and tools (such as CreatorIQ, Traackr, Grin, or similar) and social listening or analytics tools
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to report on campaign performance, interpret engagement data, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
An authentic interest in creator culture and social platforms, with an understanding of what makes influencer content feel genuine versus forced
An appreciation for inclusive representation, with experience or a strong interest in working with diverse creators who reflect a broad range of backgrounds, identities, body types, and experiences
Highly organised, with a proactive, solutions-focused approach to managing complexity
Professional proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus, particularly if relevant to multi-market expansion

Gen AI and Agentic Thinking: 

Working proficiency with Gen AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) to support creator research, brief development, reporting, and programme communications
Agentic mindset: ability to self-direct, prioritise across competing workstreams, identify opportunities, and find efficient solutions independently
Willingness to experiment with AI tools to improve influencer identification, content analysis, trend monitoring, and workflow efficiency
Understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, with a commitment to human judgement in relationship management, creative evaluation, and brand alignment decisions

Qualifications: 

Formal bachelor´s Degree is a must. 
Must live in Mexico City or metropolitan area. 
Mid Level to advanced Professional proficiency in English, writing and speaking is required. 
Experience working in creative agencies is very important to have

NICE TO HAVE 

Experience working on Dove or Unilever brands
Experience in an in-house agency, embedded studio, or social-specialist environment
Multi-market influencer programme experience, with an understanding of adapting creator strategies across regions and cultures
Experience with influencer-led content production, including on-set coordination and creator direction
A background in social media management or content creation alongside influencer management
Experience working with creators on purpose-led or social impact campaigns
Familiarity with social commerce and affiliate-driven influencer models

About the job

Descripción del Empleo




Estamos buscando conocer a nuestro nuevo Business Development Representative, para que se una a nuestro equipo en Estado de México y contribuya a nuestra misión de democratizar la Educación K12 en Latam.




Como Business Development Representative en Luca, trabajarás directamente con el equipo de ventas de Luca e interactuarás también con otros departamentos.




¿Quién eres?




Sabes lo que es la empatía y te gusta la autonomía. También eres un Business Development Representative motivado que cree que este planeta sería mucho mejor gracias a la educación.

Te encanta un entorno de ritmo rápido, pero también sabes que el "ritmo rápido" puede ser increíblemente divertido, zen y solidario.




Debes estar orientado a los objetivos y tener ganas de implementar procesos, automatizaciones y trabajar con herramientas. Puedes trabajar sin ningún tipo de supervisión o tutoría, pero no te importa preguntar si es necesario.

Gran aptitud para las ventas técnicas demostrada a través de una combinación de experiencia en la industria, tamaño y complejidad de acuerdos cerrados. Tener experiencia previa en ventas de tecnología (SaaS y API)

Carnet de conducir y coche propio
Disponibilidad para viajar
Sueldo fijo y comisiones atractivas
Trabajo Hibrido




¿Por qué unirse a Luca?




Porque nos encanta lo que hacemos y siempre aspiramos a contratar a gente mejor que nosotros. En Luca tendrás la rara oportunidad de trabajar en una cultura de start-up vibrante y energizante, con jerarquías planas y con unos valores fundamentales muy claros: empatía, autonomía y diversión.




❤️ Personas - Trata a los compañeros y clientes como tratarías a tu familia, siempre.
🚀Autonomía - Tú, tus opiniones y acciones son apreciadas, pero hazlo con responsabilidad.
🏖️Diversión - Diviértete, vete a lo lejos, vete de fiesta, de manera que colabores en la construcción de la mejor plataforma educativa del mundo.




Somos un equipo diverso y descentralizado en Remote working. No tenemos espacio para la arrogancia, la palabrería corporativa vacía, la falta de empatía o el maltrato. Tratamos a la gente como trataríamos a nuestra familia, de verdad, y también creemos que la gente debe tener diversión, flexibilidad y buenos beneficios, pero sabiendo que el trabajo duro es muy importante para construir algo grande (mental health friendly:).




En Luca también puedes:




Trabajar en una de las empresas de Edtech de más rápido crecimiento en el mundo.
Estar en el mejor lugar para ser desafiado y ser parte de un equipo divertido al mismo tiempo.




Más acerca de Luca




Luca evoluciona el futuro de la educación consolidándose como la startup EdTech K-12 de más rápido crecimiento a nivel mundial. Recientemente cerramos nuestra Serie A, alcanzando los 13M USD de financiación, respaldada por fondos globales como 6 Degrees Capital (UK), Heartcore (Dinamarca) y Shilling (Portugal) y conformada por un equipo de primer nivel con experiencia en empresas como Uber, Morgan Stanley, Kavak y Rappi. Luca está creciendo a un ritmo acelerado y seguimos buscando top talent para escalar nuestras operaciones.




Fundada en Portugal, con operaciones en México y con planes de expansión hacia otras latitudes, hoy llegamos a más de 30,000 estudiantes con nuestra solución educativa híbrida. Luca ha sido reconocida en distintos escenarios importantes como: GSV Cup (Top 3 EdTechs del mundo), HolonIQ (Top 100 EdTechs de LATAM) y avalados por el Tecnológico de Monterrey a través del Institute for the Future of Education, se registró un 20% de incremento en el aprendizaje del sistema educativo de LUCA..

description:
About the job

Objective

We request the incorporation of 1 senior profile with a high degree of autonomy, omnichannel e-commerce, systems thinking, strong AI focus, and deep business understanding to accelerate our transformation from a transactional company to a relational omni-channel company, scaling our capabilities through automation, personalization, and design efficiency.




Role mission

Own the evolution of the Kavak Core App Experience, creating a seamless, intuitive, and beautiful customer journey across the entire lifecycle—from first discovery through purchase, ownership, retention, and future transactions.

This role sits at the center of the product organization, partnering across every vertical to ensure customers experience one coherent Kavak rather than a collection of independent products. You’ll combine deep product thinking, customer research, experimentation, data, and exceptional craft to continuously raise the quality of the experience while helping define the future vision of the app.




Why this role is unique? 

You’ll help define the future of one of Latin America’s largest consumer products as Kavak evolves from a transactional marketplace into an AI-powered relationship with every customer.

Rather than owning a single feature or funnel, you’ll shape the experience customers interact with every day—bringing together buying, selling, financing, ownership, and AI into one seamless product.

This role combines:

Product strategy
Customer research
Design craft
Experimentation
AI
Systems thinking
Cross-functional leadership

If you enjoy connecting dots across products, collaborating with talented teams, and creating elegant experiences that millions of people use, this is one of the highest-impact design roles at Kavak.
